title: RAINGLASS
art_style: Rain-drenched neon noir, high-contrast shadows, holographic data overlays
short_summary: In a near-future arcology, Dr. Sarah Chen uncovers sabotage within the AI-CORE system linked to a trusted colleague, Elena Volkov, deepening the mystery of Dr. Park's death and corporate betrayal.
world_context: Near-future 2040s Neo-San Francisco Pacifica Arcology, a vertical city of glass and steel towers with ceaseless artificial rain and neon reflections. Corporate espionage and AI ethics dominate the tense atmosphere.

characters.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
characters.physical_traits: Asian-American woman, mid-30s, sharp eyes, short black hair with subtle blue highlights, often wears sleek lab coat with neon trim
quirks: Restless hands, meticulous note-taking, often bites lower lip when stressed
characters.typical_attire: Futuristic lab coat with neon accents, slim tech glasses
characters.backstory: AI ethics scientist, loyal to science but torn by betrayal after discovering sabotage in AI-CORE.
characters.motivations: Driven to uncover truth behind Park's death and protect AI integrity.

characters.name: Elena Volkov
characters.physical_traits: Slavic woman, early 30s, icy blue eyes, platinum blonde hair in a tight bun, sharp angular features
quirks: Cold stare, precise movements, rarely shows emotion
characters.typical_attire: Corporate engineer uniform, dark with subtle red accents, always carries a neural pad
characters.backstory: Engineer and corporate spy, manipulative and ruthless, betrays colleagues for personal gain.
characters.motivations: Sabotage AI-CORE to advance hidden agendas and secure power.

characters.name: Dr. James Park
characters.physical_traits: Middle-aged man, South Asian descent, salt-and-pepper hair, kind eyes behind round glasses
quirks: Idealistic, trusting, often distracted by work
characters.typical_attire: Casual lab wear, loose shirt, always with a neural pad
characters.backstory: Visionary AI scientist, victim of sabotage and murder.
characters.motivations: Pushed boundaries of AI ethics and control.

chapters.chapter_summary: Sarah decrypts Park's secret files, uncovering encrypted neural protocols and evidence of sabotage within AI-CORE. She discovers unauthorized access traced to Elena Volkov, revealing a web of betrayal.

scenes.scene_description: Sarah works late decrypting Park's secret files, uncovering hidden encrypted neural protocols and signs of sabotage.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Rain-drenched neon noir style. Establishing shot of a dimly lit, high-tech secure data room filled with holographic displays and glowing neural interface panels. Neon blue and violet light reflects off sleek surfaces, rain visible through a distant window. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah sits at a holographic console, focused on decrypting files.
panels.color_palette: cool blues and purples with neon highlights

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Rain-drenched neon noir style. Medium shot of Dr. Sarah Chen's hands trembling slightly as they manipulate a glowing neural pad interface, streams of encrypted code cascading in holographic form. Her face is partially lit by the screen's glow, eyes wide with concentration and anxiety. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah's hands tremble while decrypting files.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Rain-drenched neon noir style. Close-up of the neural pad screen showing complex encrypted neural protocols and corrupted AI-CORE logs with highlighted traces of unauthorized access. The holographic code flickers with glitch effects. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Encrypted neural protocols and sabotage traces revealed on screen.

dialogue.text: Hidden folders revealed encrypted neural protocols challenging corporate AI control. Sabotage, not glitch.

panels.color_palette: glowing blues with red glitch highlights

pages.page_description: Sarah decrypts Park's secret files, revealing sabotage.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Rain-drenched neon noir style. Medium shot of Dr. Sarah Chen's face illuminated by the neural pad's glow, eyes wide with shock and betrayal. Her lips part slightly, and her brows furrow deeply. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah reacts emotionally to the discovery.
panels.color_palette: cool blues with warm skin tones

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Rain-drenched neon noir style. Close-up of the neural pad screen pinging with an alert: unauthorized access traced to Elena Volkov's terminal. The alert flashes red with a sharp beep icon. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Neural pad alerts unauthorized access from Elena's terminal.

dialogue.text: Unauthorized access traced to Elena Volkov’s terminal.

panels.color_palette: red alert glow against dark background

pages.page_description: Sarah realizes the betrayal as the neural pad alerts her.

scenes.scene_description: Sarah processes the emotional impact of Elena's betrayal, grappling with trust and the tightening web of deception.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Rain-drenched neon noir style. Close-up of Sarah's face, eyes glistening with unshed tears, jaw clenched in determination. Neon reflections dance on her skin. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah struggles with feelings of betrayal.
panels.color_palette: cool blues with warm skin tones

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Rain-drenched neon noir style. Medium shot of Sarah standing, looking out a rain-streaked window with neon city lights blurred beyond. Her posture is tense, shoulders slightly hunched. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah contemplates the tightening web of deception.
panels.color_palette: neon blues and purples with rain reflections

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Rain-drenched neon noir style. Close-up of Sarah's hand gripping the edge of a sleek console, knuckles white, tension visible. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah's physical reaction to stress and betrayal.

pages.page_description: Sarah processes betrayal and steels herself.
